verdict.rationale: A tax agency could plausibly offer a programmatic e-file or account API, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no documented API at all, let alone one that matches the UI. The OpenAPI and llms.txt probes all returned 404. Filings, payments and registrations are shown only through the authenticated interactive Taxpayer Portal. The 1099 XML upload follows IRS schemas but is a file format submitted through that portal, not an API. The 'For Tax Software Developers' item is only a page heading with no API content.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
